requirements.statement: Projections owns deterministic compilation and execution of contract-backed projection queries, including filters, sorting, grouping, cursor binding, and keyset-bounded pagination.
Projections validates the complete code-backed provider catalog, source authority, storage ownership, capabilities, query surfaces, and deterministic rebuild ordering before use.
Projections performs deterministic incident and restore rebuilds from source-owner keyset-paged inputs and replaces stale derived rows without treating projections as source authority.
Projections exclusively owns workbook projection table SQL, closed upsert-or-delete mutation application, and transaction-bound projection storage lifecycle.
